scope: Actual CARC CPU work-precision results; read-only review of saved evidence. No new PDE solves, training, changes to frozen protocol or Tower application.

experiment.reference_scope: Same-grid coupled FP64 RK4 n/2n/4n; full last RMS difference and rounding allowance; sqrt(N)*RMS maximum estimate is not a certificate
experiment.timing_scope: Prepared full CPU rollouts: all-method warmup once, then five rotated/interleaved repeats; validation and stop checks timed; setup separately timed
experiment.setup_inclusive_scope: One separately timed preparation sample plus median warmed rollout; excludes cache-metadata reporting, reference, warmup, parity, cloning, endpoint errors, reports and post-hoc selection; not a physical cold-cache measurement
experiment.selection_scope: posthoc_declared_grid; reference-informed, not a deployable adaptive policy
experiment.work_scope: Per-rollout actual method counters, including attempted invalid work; failed-call partial counters may be incomplete; no reference or setup work hidden in rollout counts
experiment.scope: Fixed-horizon, prepared CPU work–precision diagnostic; no training or adaptive controller
interpretation: Candidate selection is post hoc over the declared step grid using the reference; it is not a deployable adaptive policy.
RMS and maximum error define separate frontiers; feasibility uses error plus accepted refinement uncertainty.
sqrt(N) times the RMS reference uncertainty is a conservative maximum-norm estimate, not a rigorous certificate.
The coupled FP64 reference has the same spatial grid; no continuum accuracy claim follows.
All methods have prepared coefficients, one complete warmup, and five interleaved complete rollout measurements.
Setup-inclusive time is preparation plus median warmed rollout; it excludes reference, warmup, parity and post-hoc selection.
Preparation is one timed sample in a predeclared rotating order; its sampling noise is not estimated.
The bank is a partial stress design with coupled factors, not a full factorial or independent statistical sample.
Historical controls retain the earlier 2D and high-rate weaknesses; every invalid candidate and unattained target is retained.
This diagnostic establishes neither neural/FNO benefit nor GPU performance nor a population-wide ranking.

software_consistency.dirty_flag_interpretation: Dirty flag is retained. Source fingerprints match both Git trees; it does not identify which files made the entire checkout dirty.

job_resources.limitation: The archive contains application records for an allocated CPU worker and verified request metadata, but no sacct/scontrol accounting, actual CPU usage, actual peak RSS or independent scheduler attestation. Four requested CPUs are not four measured compute threads.

reporting_exclusions.interpretation: Expected reporting/cache/work exclusions, including the Tower report parent. Not omitted science rows or budget truncation.

csv_projection.null_semantics: Absent = empty; observed null = literal null; bool = true/false; nested arrays use compact JSON.

limitations: The archive contains application records for an allocated CPU worker and verified request metadata, but no sacct/scontrol accounting, actual CPU usage, actual peak RSS or independent scheduler attestation. Four requested CPUs are not four measured compute threads.
Hashes establish internal byte consistency with the upload and pinned Git trees, not independent attestation of the remote machine or scientific accuracy.
Stage/workflow/Tower records are internally consistent application evidence. No new CARC execution or scheduler query was performed.
Numerical correctness, error-model limitations and scientific interpretation are outside this integrity audit; original INCONCLUSIVE scientific outcome is retained.
Same-grid discrete references and refinement uncertainty are not rigorous certificates or continuum estimates.
One excluded reference remains excluded; analysis never changes frozen acceptance or feasibility thresholds.
Subgroups describe a coupled partial stress design, not independent cases, full factorial effects, or significance.
Paired resolved wins use an explicitly descriptive separation >2 times recorded reference uncertainty.
Apparent temporal orders at errors >10 times reference uncertainty are a descriptive floor screen, not a new acceptance rule.
Canonical parity saves absolute differences but not correction/state magnitudes; true relative correction/state errors cannot be recovered. Relative-to-allowed-tolerance values are labeled as such.
Squared-error decomposition uses RMS squared = mean bias squared + zero-mean spatial error squared.
Small scalar differences in total method error are not endpoint differences; recorded rollout parity is the endpoint difference evidence.
No neural, FNO, GPU, continuum, population-wide or deployable adaptive policy claim follows.

cost.ratio_interpretation: Ratios retain their field labels: pair summaries are comparator/a, while paired_spectral_over_control is explicitly spectral/control. All summary medians are medians of paired ratios. Rows across steps, norms and tolerances reuse conditions. reference_excluded is a subset of neither_feasible, not an additional disjoint count.
limitations: Ratios use the numerator/denominator identified by their field labels; each compares the same condition, norm and tolerance with independently chosen measured steps. Aggregate medians are medians of paired ratios, not ratios of marginal medians.
Aggregated norm/tolerance rows reuse the same diagnostic conditions and often candidates; they are descriptive, not independent parents or statistical replicates.
Min/max overlap uses all five raw warmed repeats; setup intervals shift these by the single measured preparation cost and do not assess preparation variability.
All frontiers are frozen-grid post-hoc diagnostics, not step controllers.
Same-step cost evidence includes all 24 conditions because reference rejection excludes accuracy, not recorded timing.

recommendation.primary: Investigate a compact spatial correction with fused or batched coefficient evaluation; keep prepared ETDRK4 and full GL3 as controls.
recommendation.mean_branch: Keep spectral evaluation for the mean ablation; it wins no accepted complete-solver frontier and should not be the lead architecture on this evidence.
recommendation.quadrature: Retain GL5 as a control for the one observed step-count benefit, not a universal upgrade.
recommendation.followup: A separately versioned bounded CPU follow-up should preserve error thresholds, permit an additional bounded reference refinement, separate within-regime amplitude effects, and measure batch/grid scaling before a new training campaign.
constraints: Do not promote reference-excluded comparisons in this existing report.
Do not force a learned remainder to start at h^4; missing finite-amplitude terms can enter at h^3.
The analytic raw-mean correction is approximate nonlinear physics; do not hard-code total mass conservation or exact mean evolution.
Future neural comparisons need parent-disjoint selection and diagnostic tests, comparable physical inputs and cores, and matched full-rollout costs.
